subtitle: Lesson 14 · Linux Fundamentals I — The Shell & Filesystem

code:
$ sudo apt update
$ sudo apt upgrade
$ sudo apt install nginx
$ sudo apt remove nginx
$ apt search nginx
caption: update refreshes the package list only; upgrade and install actually change what's on disk.

code:
$ sudo dnf check-update
$ sudo dnf update
$ sudo dnf install nginx
$ sudo dnf remove nginx
$ dnf search nginx
caption: dnf (Dandified YUM) replaced the older yum — nearly identical syntax, same command shapes as apt.
